# folder-note-site

Covers: Obsidian folder notes (no single doc page)

Exercises Obsidian-style folder notes where a folder and its `index.md` are treated as one page. The `input/obsidian/` subtree was absorbed from the former `obsidian-test-site` bare fixture (deleted); it provides an additional multi-section Obsidian vault layout for coverage.

See `basic-site/README.md` for the regeneration procedure.
